backend.schema_ownership: Stage12-21 versioned SQL remains canonical; Django must not create duplicate identity or learning tables

frontend.api_client: OpenAPI-derived types and server-side API client

integration.topology: Browser -> Next.js server boundary -> Django REST API /api/v1 -> application/domain services -> PostgreSQL
integration.auth_transport: Next.js server-side boundary forwards Bearer access tokens; browser persistence in localStorage is forbidden
integration.same_origin: Prefer one public origin with /api/v1 reverse-proxied to Django
integration.business_logic: selection, scoring, mastery, Error Review, SRS and authorization remain Django/backend-only

service_boundaries.AUTH: credentials, sessions, access-token verification and role claims
service_boundaries.CONTENT: read-only lessons, subtopics and stable taxonomy identifiers
service_boundaries.TEST_ORCHESTRATION: Stage13/14 selection, immutable test snapshots and attempt lifecycle
service_boundaries.ANSWER_PIPELINE: answer validation, scoring and one transaction across answer, mastery, error-review and SRS state
service_boundaries.ERROR_REVIEW: Stage16 filters, groups, retry/reveal/mark events and resolution state
service_boundaries.MASTERY: Stage15 computation and persisted current/snapshot resources

auth_policy.ownership_rule: learner resources require principal.sub == resource.user_id; unauthorized ownership checks return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND to prevent enumeration
auth_policy.logout_rule: revoke the server-side session identified by sid; all later tokens for that session fail closed
auth_policy.authorization_location: Django REST Framework permission plus application/service ownership checks; never UI-only

idempotency.same_request: return the original status/body and Idempotent-Replayed: true
idempotency.request_fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical JSON body plus stable path parameters

query_standard.pagination: opaque cursor using page[size] and page[after]
query_standard.filter_syntax: filter[field]=value; repeat parameters for multi-value filters

answer_safety.after_submission: only the submitted item may reveal correctness and feedback
answer_safety.result_gate: full result is available only after attempt COMPLETED
answer_safety.admin_exception: authorized staff review resources may include the answer key

answer_order: validate ownership, attempt state, frozen question and option
update Stage15 current mastery and append snapshot
materialize/update Stage16 error-review state when applicable
update Stage17 concept schedule and append event
transaction_contract.atomicity: all writes commit or roll back together; raw answer remains the authoritative replay input after an out-of-band recovery
transaction_contract.retry: storage failures retry only through the same idempotency key

error_contract.request_id: returned on every error and correlated with logs/audit records

analytics.asynchronous: heavy rebuilds, cohort/admin aggregation and historical backfills
analytics.dashboard_rule: one aggregated dashboard resource; no chatty per-card fan-out
analytics.historical_rule: persisted snapshots only; never interpolate missing periods into a learning claim

compatibility_and_impact.existing_questions: no question content, revision, status or answer-key field is migrated by Stage21
compatibility_and_impact.historical_attempts: immutable snapshots and answers remain unchanged
compatibility_and_impact.historical_reports: new API projections read existing history without rewriting it
compatibility_and_impact.imports: Stage10/20 row schemas remain unchanged; Stage21 adds transport/idempotency storage only
compatibility_and_impact.stage20_api: all Stage20 operations are incorporated into the versioned Stage21 OpenAPI without weakening permissions or workflow gates
compatibility_and_impact.breaking_change_policy: additive changes within v1; incompatible request/response changes require /api/v2 and a migration/deprecation record

risk_controls.preventive: separate public AttemptQuestion schema and post-answer feedback schema
risk_controls.detection: contract test recursively rejects forbidden answer-key fields before submission

risk_controls.detection: Stage24 query-count/performance budgets for list, next-question and dashboard resources

risk_controls.detection: adapter tests plus service-boundary review and unit tests that invoke domain/application services without HTTP

risk_controls.preventive: versioned base path, immutable operation IDs and OpenAPI compatibility review
